_comment: HUGE's eyes are bolt-on plates on the FRONT of the frame only; the scan copied them onto the rear faces of both arms (tripo_part_3 / _7) as well. +x is the authoring front — catalog modelYaw turns it into game -z — so the rear pair is what -x sees. minBlobPixels keeps the two eye blobs (~30k px each) and drops rivets and panel shadows; flatten relaxes the relief the scan embossed under the paint.
